nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Content-only viewer component for the Code Editor's active file pane; resolves relative path/preview type via useCodeViewerHandlers and dispatches to the loading/error/binary/content sub-views, leaving the tab bar to its parent.

nodes.name: CodeViewerContentInner
nodes.summary: Inner file-content renderer that resolves the relative path and preview type, then dispatches to LoadingView/ErrorView/BinaryView/ContentView based on file state; wrapped by the exported memoized CodeViewerContent.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the CodeViewerContent component tree, including its main props interface and shared file-state shapes reused by the loading/error/binary/content sub-views.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility helpers for the code viewer: relative-path resolution and file-extension classifiers (markdown/html/json/csv/previewable) plus a custom memo comparator for the viewer's props.

nodes.name: getRelativePath
nodes.summary: Strips a repo root prefix (with octal-path decoding) from an absolute file path to produce a display-friendly relative path.

nodes.name: isMarkdownFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file path has a markdown extension (.md/.mdx/.markdown).

nodes.name: isHtmlFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file path has an HTML extension.

nodes.name: isJsonFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file path has a .json extension.

nodes.name: isCsvFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file path has a .csv or .tsv extension.

nodes.name: isPreviewableFile
nodes.summary: Delegates to supportsPreviewToggle to determine if a file type supports the preview toggle.

nodes.name: arePropsEqual
nodes.summary: Custom memo comparator for CodeViewerContent that limits re-renders to changes in the fields that actually affect rendered output.

nodes.name: BinaryView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the binary/unsupported-preview state of the code viewer, tracking unsaved preview state and surfacing reload/save controls for non-text files.

nodes.name: BinaryView
nodes.summary: Displays a binary file placeholder with breadcrumb, preview-unsaved tracking via effect, and reload/save action wiring.

nodes.name: ContentView.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary text-content view of the code viewer: renders the CodeMirror-backed editor/preview surface, wires cursor/selection/diagnostics callbacks, conflict resolution, and SKILL.md frontmatter parsing.

nodes.name: ContentView
nodes.summary: Renders the main editable/preview content area, deriving markdown/html/json/csv preview flags, parsing SKILL.md frontmatter, and wiring find/go-to-line/cursor/selection/diagnostic callbacks to the editor service.

nodes.name: ErrorView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the code viewer's error state with a translated message and reload/preview-toggle actions when a file fails to load.

nodes.name: ErrorView
nodes.summary: Shows an i18n error message for a failed file load along with breadcrumb, reload, and preview-toggle controls.

nodes.name: LoadingView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the code viewer's loading/placeholder state while file content is being fetched, including breadcrumb and disabled save controls.

nodes.name: LoadingView
nodes.summary: Displays a loading placeholder for the code viewer with breadcrumb and save/discard controls disabled during fetch.

nodes.name: PlanFileActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the 'Execute Plan' button shown in the file header when a .plan.md file is open, launching the plan using the live editor content via PlanExecutionService.

nodes.name: SkillFrontmatterPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Editable 'Properties' panel shown atop SKILL.md previews that parses YAML frontmatter into rows, supports adding/editing/removing properties, and serializes edits back into file content.

nodes.name: PropertyRow
nodes.summary: Renders and edits a single frontmatter key/value row, debouncing text commits and supporting array-valued properties.

nodes.name: AddPropertyRow
nodes.summary: Inline control for adding a new frontmatter property, managing key/value draft state and commit/cancel/keyboard handling.

nodes.name: SkillFrontmatterPanel
nodes.summary: Top-level frontmatter panel that keeps local frontmatter state in sync with props, applies edits, and renders the property rows plus add-row control.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export re-exposing the code viewer's BinaryView, ContentView, ErrorView, and LoadingView sub-components.

nodes.name: skillFrontmatter.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the SKILL.md frontmatter parse/serialize/format helpers and types from the shared skills utility module for local use by the viewer's views.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export for all file preview components (image, video, JSON tree, DB, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, Pages) and their prop types, plus the shared preview bottom bar and file-size formatter.

nodes.name: AllChangesView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Source Control 'all changes' list view, loading diff content/stats per file, auto-collapsing groups on file-list changes, and scrolling to a target file section.

nodes.name: AllChangesView
nodes.summary: Lists all changed files with lazy diff-content loading via useAllChangesFiles, group-collapse animation triggers, and scroll-into-view targeting for a focused file.

nodes.name: FocusView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Source Control 'focused file' view showing a single git file's diff/content with reload, close, and unsaved-change handling.

nodes.name: FocusView
nodes.summary: Displays the focused git file's diff content, header, and empty-state actions, propagating unsaved-change and close events to the parent.

nodes.name: useAllChangesFiles.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that manages diff stats and content for the Source Control 'all changes' view: batches git diff requests per repo group, tracks loaded/in-flight state via refs, resolves untracked-file content directly, and exposes sorted files plus section-ref helpers for scroll targeting.

nodes.name: useAllChangesFiles
nodes.summary: Loads and caches per-file git diff stats/content in batches, resolves untracked file content from disk, keeps state in sync as the incoming files list changes, and returns sorted files with section-ref accessors.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers for the all-changes view: repo-path resolution, relative-path computation, diff-map lookup key generation, line counting, and derivation of effective added/removed line stats.

nodes.name: getEffectiveRepoPath
nodes.summary: Returns the file's own repo path or falls back to the provided default.

nodes.name: getRelativePath
nodes.summary: Strips a repo path prefix from a file path to produce a relative path.

nodes.name: getDiffLookupKeys
nodes.summary: Builds the set of candidate keys (relative and octal-decoded) used to look up a file's diff in the diff map.

nodes.name: countContentLines
nodes.summary: Counts the number of lines in a content string.

nodes.name: getEffectiveDiffStats
nodes.summary: Derives added/removed line counts for a file, preferring backend diff stats and falling back to comparing old/new content lengths.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Composes the Source Control main content area, switching between the all-changes and focused-file views, wiring issue-comment/close/reopen callbacks scoped to the active repo and selected issue.

nodes.name: SourceControlMainContent
nodes.summary: Renders either AllChangesView or FocusView based on mode/focus state, and wires issue close/reopen/add-comment callbacks scoped by repo and selected-issue atoms.

nodes.name: SourceControlMainPane.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level Source Control pane that derives view props from tab/git state via deriveSourceControlMainProps and renders SourceControlMainContent, wiring issue callbacks scoped to the active repo.

nodes.name: SourceControlMainPane
nodes.summary: Derives the source-control view props from tab data and git file state, and renders the composed SourceControlMainContent with issue-comment/close/reopen callbacks.

nodes.name: sourceControlMainProps.ts
nodes.summary: Pure derivation logic (extracted for testability) that resolves the GitFile for a focus path and computes the props needed to drive the Source Control main pane, independent of React.

nodes.name: getGitFileForPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the GitFile entry for a given path against the working-tree status map, handling exact, host-relative, and repo-root-prefixed (worktree) path matches.

nodes.name: deriveSourceControlMainProps
nodes.summary: Computes the Source Control main-pane props (focused file, filtered file list, staged/all-changes mode) from tab data, git files, and filter mode.

nodes.name: editorHostContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context that publishes the Code Editor host's live state and action surface (file content manager, terminal state, diagnostics) above the unified tab dispatcher so per-tab renderers can consume it directly instead of via a large prop bag.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a specific pitfall: the provider must be mounted with the SAME live-state instances EditorMainPane already holds, since recreating fileContentState/terminalState per tab breaks editing and running terminals.

nodes.name: EditorHostProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component that supplies the editor host context value to descendant tab renderers.

nodes.name: useEditorHostContext
nodes.summary: Hook that reads the editor host context, throwing if used outside EditorHostProvider.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export for the EditorMainPane's pane-state, file-content-manager, and tab-content-sync hooks.

nodes.name: useEditorPaneState.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing per-pane editor tab layout state: active/inner tabs, save/discard/save-all with unsaved-change confirmation dialogs, tab close/reorder, and CSV-table-file detection, dispatching global save/discard events.

nodes.name: useEditorPaneState
nodes.summary: Owns the editor pane's tab layout state (active tab, inner tabs list) and exposes save/discard/close/reorder actions with native confirmation dialogs for unsaved changes, plus global window event dispatch for cross-component save coordination.

nodes.name: useFileContentManager.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that wraps useFileContent to add save/discard/reload actions for the active editor tab, listening for a global save-all event and invalidating the file cache after writes.

nodes.name: useFileContentManager
nodes.summary: Manages save/discard/reload for the active file's content, writing to disk, marking saved state, invalidating cache, and responding to a global 'save all' window event.

nodes.name: useTabContentSync.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that keeps editor tab state synchronized with the action-system dispatcher, debouncing updates and clearing pending timers on unmount/tab change.

nodes.name: useTabContentSync
nodes.summary: Synchronizes tab content state with the action-system store, debouncing dispatches via setTimeout and clearing timers appropriately.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level Code Editor main pane component that renders the active tab's content (terminal, code viewer, source control, etc.) behind a lazy-loaded boundary, wiring the header, editor host context, and quick actions for the whole editor surface.
nodes.languageNotes: The 834-line default-exported EditorContent component is defined as `const EditorContent: React.FC<...> = memo((props) => {...})`, a pattern the tree-sitter extractor does not capture as a named function declaration; only the trivial LazyFallback helper was detected.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the EditorMainPane's tab model, panel state, cursor position, diagnostics, and git-file shapes shared across the editor's content and hooks.

nodes.name: PreviewContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders read-only previews (markdown, JSON tree, lazily-loaded CSV table) of file content for the session-replay Code Panel, reusing FilePreviewContent's JsonTreeView.
